claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Cefdinir is a cephalosporin antibiotic with no meaningful cytotoxic activity against human cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any apparent effect would reflect weak, non-specific antibacterial or physicochemical activity rather than a genuine anticancer mechanism.
